correctness.rationale: The mass normalization algebra exactly follows the two cited identities. The tilt endpoint has density v^(k-1)/(k-1)! locally and beta-integral asymptotic first and second moments, with exponentially small omitted mass. The binomial score and second derivative bounds give O(R^-1) TV from the mixture to its exact-mean binomial, and the binomial CLT gives the stated positive leading root-R constant for the O(R^-1) success-parameter displacement. The proof controls the tails and all fixed-parameter quantifiers. Replayed exact-rational and numerical checks support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The fixed-k, fixed-positive-phi spillage law is a natural conditional-occupancy distribution with existing binomial-scale approximations but without a sharp validated total-variation error rate in inspected sources. The exact positive constant quantifies a nontrivial accuracy limit and separates the first-order effect of a shifted mixing mean from the lower-order randomness of the mixing law; it is motivated by practical distributional approximation rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
